fields.Name: T64 - Entity Form Related Records Course
fields.Description: Verifies a Course record's related Enrollments section is present.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Courses' entity via the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box, open a course record's full form, scroll to its related-records sections and open the 'Enrollments' section. Verify the Enrollments related section is present for that course — it shows enrollment rows, OR a count badge (e.g. a number like '16' on the section), OR a valid loading/empty-state. The related section being present and indicating its enrollments (rows or a count) is success; the grid may be slow to populate. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A Course record full form is open
The 'Enrollments' related section is present (rows, a count badge, or a valid loading/empty-state)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
